A [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] '''engineer''' was responsible for designing the [[protodeka]], a giant, [[Crab/Legends|crablike]] siege weapon,<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]],<ref name="Protodeka">{{CSWECite|III|47|Protodeka}}</ref> which was manufactured by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]<ref name="Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Dark Reaper crisis]]. He was then cloistered by his brethren in the [[Fortress of Axion]], a [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]] fortress on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Axion]] that served as Separatist research and development center during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], making him a tempting target for a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] extradition mission.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] dispatched several [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Brolis]] to Axion to [[Battle of Axion|extract]] the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]. While the small force was able to penetrate the fortress through a hole within the foundation within two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of making planetfall. However, the Colicoids were able to contact the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] in the intervening [[Time/Legends|time]], who flushed the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] from the fortress and secured a Separatist victory, the only Republic survivors of the battle being Brolis and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Colicoid engineer was first mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> and published on [[October 25]], [[2005]].<ref name="CargoBay">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=32326|text=Daniel Wallace}}</ref>
